{{Quote|There's an abomination of a clan that holds fortress in a cave near the Great Canyon. We need someone to scout out this place for a weakness in their defenses. These heretics must be eradicated!|[[Leandra]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:SWL">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|Spell Weaver Leandra|Dathomir}}</ref>}}
The '''Nightspider Cult cave''',<ref name="SWG:NCC" /> also known as the '''Nighsister Spider cave''',<ref name="Sony">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Travel%20Guide|text=10 Hot Spots Travel Guide}}</ref> was the dwelling for the members of [[Spiderclan/Legends|Spiderclan]], a clan of [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:NCC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Nightspider Cult cave was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:NCC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
